company.name: Community Phone
company.shortDescription: Community Phone provides easy-to-use, dependable landline phone service for households and businesses.
company.description: At Community Phone, we provide simple, reliable phone service for both homes and businesses. Our service doesn’t require the internet and continues to work during power outages. It’s powered by the Community Phone base, a device that connects your phone directly to cell towers in your area. Just plug it in, connect your phone and enjoy unlimited local and long-distance calls across the U.S.

productsAndServices.description: A wireless landline phone service that operates without internet or traditional phone wiring, providing nationwide coverage and backup power during outages.
productsAndServices.name: Community Phone Landline Service

productsAndServices.description: A plug-and-play business phone system with mobile app integration, shared phone lines, call routing, and call forwarding features.
productsAndServices.name: Community Phone Business Phone System

productsAndServices.description: An application that allows users to make and receive calls, access voicemail, and manage shared phone lines from mobile devices or desktop computers.
productsAndServices.name: Community Phone Mobile and Desktop App

productsAndServices.description: A built-in system that automatically filters and blocks up to 99% of robocalls, AI scams, and telemarketers without user setup.
productsAndServices.name: Spam and Scam Call Blocking

productsAndServices.description: Features including call forwarding, call routing, shared numbers, simultaneous ringing, and missed call auto-text to improve call handling and communication efficiency.
productsAndServices.name: Advanced Call Management Features

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,342,955 to $33,655,790, a 14.36x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 20 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
